summary.text: Mark Cusack is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Norfolk District since 2011 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Cusack took office in 2011 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Rules Committee, the Rules Joint Committee, and the Telecommunications, Utilities and Energy Joint Committee, which he chairs. In earlier sessions, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Revenue Joint Committee.
